Usage:
  agentscope task [command]

Available Commands:
  cancel      
  child       Delegate child work from the current Team leader task
  complete    Complete the current AgentTask and reconcile its inputs
  context     Read the authoritative task-scoped collaboration context
  fail        Fail the current AgentTask with a durable error
  get         
  list        
  progress    Post durable progress for the current AgentTask
  respond     Post an attributable result for the current AgentTask
  retry       
  run         Operate on the Run containing the current AgentTask

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for task

Global Flags:
      --api-endpoint string   Control plane REST API endpoint (default "http://127.0.0.1:18080")
